remarks: Amazing Development Opportunity in Buffalo’s Historic Black Rock Neighborhood! Bring your architectural blueprints or investment plans to this prime residential vacant lot located at 131 Thompson Street. Situated on a quiet, established street on Buffalo's vibrant West Side, this rectangular, flat parcel offers the perfect canvas for a custom single-family home or a multi-family build. This lot sits in a highly walkable community with immediate access to local shops, dining, and public transit. It is just minutes from the Niagara River, Buffalo State University, and the Scajaquada Expressway for an effortless commute anywhere in the city. Public utilities (water, sewer, gas, and electric) are readily available at the street line. Whether you are looking to build your dream home, construct a high-yield rental unit, or expand your local land portfolio, this property is a rare find. Seller is also owner of separately listed 133 Thompson St, the two properties can be combined for a sale as a package deal. Don’t let this affordable piece of Buffalo real estate pass you by!
